description: A template GitHub Repository for you to generate repos from. Then in the builds folder add static html (other platforms go to itch.io and its devlogs) builds of your game. From repo settings, go to the Pages tab and select GitHub actions as the deploy mechanism it will automatically deploy the page for your repo on every push. For more instructions see the Readme.md.
